verdicts.reason: A strips the floral wreath out of the design: it shrinks to a tiny ring stranded at the lower left, the white circle floats with no frame, and the brand imagery is gone, so it is unusable. B keeps the wreath around the text and stays faithful to the original, but it repeats the original's clipping ('OME' and 'PICK' are hidden behind the flowers) and leaves wide empty black side bands; it reads as a scaled copy, not a banner layout.
